question: How many students are there?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM students

question: List the names of students from Lahore.
gold: SELECT name FROM students WHERE city = 'Lahore'

question: How many courses does the Computer Science department offer?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM courses WHERE department = 'Computer Science'

question: What are the titles of the courses worth 4 credits?
gold: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE credits = 4

question: List all teacher names ordered by the year they were hired, earliest first.
gold: SELECT name FROM teachers ORDER BY hire_year

question: What is the highest score recorded in any grade?
gold: SELECT max(score) FROM grades

question: How many students major in Mathematics?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM students WHERE major = 'Mathematics'

question: Which different cities do the students come from?
gold: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM students

question: List the names of the teachers whose title is Professor.
gold: SELECT name FROM teachers WHERE title = 'Professor'

question: How many students live in each city?
gold: SELECT city, count(*) FROM students GROUP BY city

question: What is the average score in each course? Show the course title.
gold: SELECT T1.title, avg(T3.score) FROM courses AS T1 JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id JOIN grades AS T3 ON T2.enrollment_id = T3.enrollment_id GROUP BY T1.course_id

question: Which teacher teaches the most courses?
gold: SELECT T1.name FROM teachers AS T1 JOIN courses AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id = T2.teacher_id GROUP BY T1.teacher_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show the names of students who got an A in Principles of Management.
gold: SELECT T1.name FROM students AS T1 JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id JOIN courses AS T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.course_id JOIN grades AS T4 ON T2.enrollment_id = T4.enrollment_id WHERE T3.title = 'Principles of Management' AND T4.letter = 'A'

question: For each department, how many enrollments are there in its courses?
gold: SELECT T2.department, count(*) FROM enrollments AS T1 JOIN courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T2.department

question: Which course has the most enrollments? Give its title.
gold: SELECT T1.title FROM courses AS T1 JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the names of teachers who do not teach any course?
gold: SELECT name FROM teachers WHERE teacher_id NOT IN (SELECT teacher_id FROM courses)

question: What is the average score of students who major in Physics?
gold: SELECT avg(T3.score) FROM students AS T1 JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id JOIN grades AS T3 ON T2.enrollment_id = T3.enrollment_id WHERE T1.major = 'Physics'

question: How many Fall 2025 enrollments do not have a grade yet?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM enrollments WHERE semester = 'Fall 2025' AND enrollment_id NOT IN (SELECT enrollment_id FROM grades)

question: Which department has the most teachers?
gold: SELECT department FROM teachers GROUP BY department ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the titles of courses taught by teachers hired after 2015.
gold: SELECT T1.title FROM courses AS T1 JOIN teachers AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id = T2.teacher_id WHERE T2.hire_year > 2015

question: What is the name of the student with the highest score?
gold: SELECT T1.name FROM students AS T1 JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id JOIN grades AS T3 ON T2.enrollment_id = T3.enrollment_id ORDER BY T3.score DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show each course title together with the name of the teacher who teaches it.
gold: SELECT T1.title, T2.name FROM courses AS T1 JOIN teachers AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id = T2.teacher_id

question: How many courses does each teacher teach? Show the teacher name and the count.
gold: SELECT T1.name, count(*) FROM teachers AS T1 JOIN courses AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id = T2.teacher_id GROUP BY T1.teacher_id

question: Which students take courses in both the Computer Science and the Mathematics departments?
gold: SELECT T1.name FROM students AS T1 JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id JOIN courses AS T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.course_id WHERE T3.department = 'Computer Science' INTERSECT SELECT T1.name FROM students AS T1 JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id JOIN courses AS T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.course_id WHERE T3.department = 'Mathematics'

question: Which courses have an average score above 70? Show their titles.
gold: SELECT T1.title FROM courses AS T1 JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id JOIN grades AS T3 ON T2.enrollment_id = T3.enrollment_id GROUP BY T1.course_id HAVING avg(T3.score) > 70

question: How many students started in each enrollment year? Order by year.
gold: SELECT enrollment_year, count(*) FROM students GROUP BY enrollment_year ORDER BY enrollment_year

question: Which letter grade was given most often?
gold: SELECT letter FROM grades GROUP BY letter ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of students who enrolled in 2025 and live in Karachi.
gold: SELECT name FROM students WHERE enrollment_year = 2025 AND city = 'Karachi'

question: What is the total number of credits of all Physics courses?
gold: SELECT sum(credits) FROM courses WHERE department = 'Physics'

question: Which students scored below 50 in at least one course?
gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM students AS T1 JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id JOIN grades AS T3 ON T2.enrollment_id = T3.enrollment_id WHERE T3.score < 50
